description: The source describes a special Act under section 47 of the Water Act permitting transfers of treated municipal drinking water from the North Saskatchewan to the Athabasca river basin. Its metadata states annual limits of 158.045 decametres for Entwistle and 13.870 decametres for Nakamun Park. Those units are preserved exactly as written: the metadata does not explicitly say cubic decametres, so a volumetric conversion is not asserted. The record provides source-stated water-supply limits, not measured transfers. The publication descriptor is a URI without an edition or file format. Current legal validity and the full text remain unverified. Geographic coverage is Alberta. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue preserves the source identifiers and descriptive metadata. The native licence is Alberta King's Printer Terms of Use. Access is labelled unrestricted but isopen is false; actual payload access and costs remain unverified. No linked dataset, workbook, document, legal text, model or code body was retrieved. Specific simulation applications beyond those explicitly described are not established.
